text: You just got ripped off the ground and pulled up into a tornado.
Air races in along the ground and spins faster and faster as it squeezes in.
Then it shoots straight up the middle and you go up with it.
The strongest ones spin at over two hundred miles an hour.
But the wind is not what hurts you the most.
It's everything spinning around you. Boards and glass and rocks flying faster than a car on the highway.
Flying junk causes most tornado deaths and injuries.
In two thousand six a teen named Matt Suter was pulled out of his trailer.
A tornado carried him one thousand three hundred and seven feet.
He landed in a field and walked to a neighbor's house.
If one is coming get to the lowest room with no windows and cover your head.
Subscribe because that's what really happens if you get sucked into a tornado.
